question: In which of the following years was Burhan-ul-Mulk appointed the Nazim of Awadh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1722**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Burhan-ul-Mulk, also known as Saadat Khan, was appointed as the **Nazim (Governor) of Awadh in 1722** by Mughal Emperor Muhammad Shah.
 
• He was entrusted with the task of stabilizing the region of Awadh, which was experiencing political and economic turmoil at the time.
 
• Burhan-ul-Mulk successfully established Awadh as a semi-independent province under the nominal control of the Mughal Empire.
 
• He laid the foundation for the Nawabi dynasty in Awadh, which later became one of the most prominent princely states in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Awadh:**

 
 
• Awadh (modern-day Uttar Pradesh) was a significant province in northern India known for its rich cultural heritage.
 
• It played a key role in the Mughal Empire and later in the British colonial era.
 
 
 
• **Saadat Khan (Burhan-ul-Mulk):**
 
 
• He was originally from Nishapur (Persia) and migrated to India during the decline of the Safavid Empire.
 
• He held significant administrative and military positions under the Mughal Emperor Muhammad Shah.
 
 
 
• **Political Scenario of the Mughal Empire in 1722:**
 
 
• The Mughal Empire was experiencing a decline in central authority during this period.
 
• Regional governors like Burhan-ul-Mulk gained autonomy while maintaining a nominal allegiance to the Mughal throne.
 
 
 
• **Nawabi of Awadh:**
 
 
• The Nawabs of Awadh established a rich cultural legacy, especially in art, music, and architecture.
 
• The region became a prominent center for the development of Urdu language and literature.
